settings.content: Lot details come from product metafields. Create these in Settings > Custom data > Products, all under the namespace 'tea': garden (single line text), altitude (single line text), harvested (date), oxidation (single line text), lot (single line text). Any field you leave empty is simply skipped.
Social links and the store address now live on the Footer section, so they can be reordered and translated with the rest of the footer.
